## Study questionnaire {#sec-appendixquestionnaire}



::: {.card}

`r targets::tar_read(config_list)[[1]][["variables"]][[3]]["label"]`

`r targets::tar_read(config_list)[[1]][["variables"]][[3]][["question"]]`

`r paste(targets::tar_read(config_list)[[1]][["variables"]][[3]][["response_options"]], collapse = "; ")`

:::


```{r, output='asis'}
targets::tar_read(config_list)[[1]][["variables"]] |>
  purrr::map(
    function(x) return(paste0(
                              "::: {.card}\n\n", 
                              x[["label"]], 
                              "\n\n",
                               x[["question"]],
                              "\n\n",
                              paste(x[["response_options"]], collapse = "; "),
                              "\n\n:::"
                              ))
  ) |>
  paste(collapse = "\n\n") |>
  cat()

```
